file_path.field: path of the entry that is the talk reminder email template

email_thread_id.field: email_thread_id of the thread from the manager containing the talk schedule

calls.pddl: (gmail-create-draft coworker-emails body-talk-1 token-gmail subject-talk-reminder reminder-datetime-talk-1 talk-1)

recipient_email_addresses.field: list of email of every returned contact (relationship == coworker)

body.field: content (template) with placeholders filled from the 1st talk entry (speaker/title/date) read via gmail.show_thread

scheduled_send_at.field: date of talk 1 of 7 in the manager's schedule e-mail, at the reminder time stated in the task (ISO datetime)
